title: S&P 500 rejects SpaceX, also blocking entry for OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: The S&P 500 index committee has declined to waive its profitability requirements for SpaceX, blocking its entry alongside leading generative AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic. Standard & Poor's enforces strict listing rules requiring four consecutive quarters of cumulative positive GAAP earnings. Despite the massive private valuations and market presence of these generative artificial intelligence pioneers, the committee chose not to grant exemptions for high-growth but currently unprofitable structures. This decision highlights ongoing tensions between traditional public market benchmarks and capital-intensive AI companies that rely on heavy private venture funding and computing infrastructure investments. (source: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/06/sp-500-blocks-fast-spacex-entry-wont-waive-rule-for-unprofitable-ai-firms/)
title_cn: S&P 500 拒绝 SpaceX，同时将 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 拒之门外
summary_cn: S&P 500 指数委员会拒绝为 SpaceX 放宽盈利要求，使其与领先的生成式 AI 公司 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 一样无法进入该指数。标准普尔执行严格的上市规则，要求连续四个季度实现累计正 GAAP 收益。尽管这些生成式人工智能先驱拥有巨大的私人估值和市场影响力，但委员会选择不对高增长但目前尚未盈利的结构给予豁免。这一决定凸显了传统公开市场基准与依赖大量私人风险投资和计算基础设施投入的资本密集型 AI 公司之间的持续紧张关系。

title: US House lawmakers release draft bill to prohibit state AI rules
summary: United States House lawmakers have released a draft bill aimed at establishing a single, centralized federal regulatory framework for artificial intelligence. The proposed legislation seeks to preempt and prohibit individual states from enacting their own conflicting AI rules, ensuring regulatory consistency across state lines. Proponents argue that a unified national standard provides clear compliance guardrails for researchers, developers, and enterprises while fostering innovation and maintaining national competitiveness. The draft bill directly addresses industry concerns over a fragmented compliance landscape, positioning the federal government as the primary authority on AI safety and operational guidelines. (source: https://www.reuters.com/business/us-house-lawmakers-release-draft-bill-regulate-ai-2026-06-04/)
title_cn: 美国众议院议员发布法案草案，旨在禁止各州制定 AI 规则
summary_cn: 美国众议院议员发布了一份法案草案，旨在建立一个单一、集中的联邦人工智能监管框架。拟议的立法旨在通过预占权禁止各州制定其各自冲突的 AI 规则，从而确保各州之间监管的一致性。支持者认为，统一的国家标准为研究人员、开发人员和企业提供了明确的合规护栏，同时促进创新并保持国家竞争力。该法案草案直接解决了行业对碎片化合规环境的担忧，确立了联邦政府作为 AI 安全和运营准则的主要权威机构地位。

title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
summary: A research paper has introduced a novel theoretical framework that establishes a unified mathematical connection between decision trees and generative diffusion models. By conceptualizing the hierarchical routing of decision trees as continuous-time flows, the authors demonstrate how traditional tree architectures can integrate with continuous-time flow matching and diffusion processes. This theoretical bridge enables the deployment of hybrid model architectures that combine the high interpretability and efficiency of discrete decision structures with the powerful generative capabilities of continuous probabilistic flows, aiming to offer faster sampling times and enhanced transparency for generative AI. (source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00414)
title_cn: 从决策树到流及反之：统一决策树与扩散模型
summary_cn: 一篇研究论文引入了一种新颖的理论框架，建立了决策树与生成式扩散模型之间的统一数学联系。通过将决策树的层次路由概念化为连续时间流，作者展示了传统树架构如何与连续时间流匹配和扩散过程相结合。这一理论桥梁使得部署混合模型架构成为可能，该架构既结合了离散决策结构的高可解释性和效率，又融合了连续概率流强大的生成能力，旨在为生成式 AI 提供更快的采样时间和增强的透明度。

title: Meta confirms 1000s of Instagram accounts were hacked by abusing its AI chatbot
summary: Meta has confirmed that attackers compromised thousands of Instagram accounts by exploiting vulnerabilities in its integrated AI chatbot. The attackers manipulated the conversational AI system to bypass standard security protocols and gain unauthorized account access. This incident serves as a critical case study in how conversational interfaces and machine learning-driven support systems can be abused to bypass authentication or extract sensitive user data. Meta has since deployed patches to secure the chatbot's API endpoints, highlighting the urgent security requirements for deploying large-scale AI applications and safeguarding conversational assistants against adversarial attacks. (source: https://this.weekinsecurity.com/meta-confirms-thousands-of-instagram-accounts-were-hacked-by-abusing-its-ai-chatbot/)
title_cn: Meta 证实数千个 Instagram 账户因滥用其 AI 聊天机器人被黑
summary_cn: Meta 已证实，攻击者通过利用其集成 AI 聊天机器人的漏洞，入侵了数千个 Instagram 账户。攻击者操纵对话式 AI 系统绕过了标准安全协议，并获得了未经授权的账户访问权限。此事件作为一个关键案例，展示了对话式界面和机器学习驱动的系统如何被滥用来绕过认证或窃取敏感用户数据。Meta 现已部署补丁以保护聊天机器人的 API 端点，凸显了部署大规模 AI 应用时对安全性的迫切要求，以及防范针对对话助手的对抗性攻击的重要性。

title: Police in England and Wales told to halt AI use in court statements
summary: Police forces in England and Wales have been instructed to halt the use of generative artificial intelligence tools for drafting court statements and witness summaries due to accuracy and safety concerns. Legal experts and regulators raised warnings that AI-generated summaries could introduce hallucinations, leading to biased or inaccurate court evidence. This temporary suspension aims to prevent miscarriages of justice and ensure evidence remains prepared by human professionals. The decision highlights the critical need for robust governance frameworks and strict testing protocols before deploying generative AI technologies in high-stakes public safety and legal environments. (source: https://www.ft.com/content/229e5949-3ebc-4151-8a86-a01b5e259241)
title_cn: 英格兰和威尔士警察被告知停止在法庭陈述中使用 AI
summary_cn: 英格兰和威尔士的警察部队已收到指示，因准确性和安全顾虑，停止在起草法庭陈述和证人证词摘要时使用生成式人工智能工具。法律专家和监管机构警告称，AI 生成的摘要可能会产生幻觉，导致法庭证据出现偏差或不准确。此次临时停用旨在防止司法误判，并确保证据由人类专业人员准备。该决定突显了在高风险公共安全和法律环境中部署生成式 AI 技术之前，建立稳健治理框架和严格测试方案的迫切需求。

title: The Smart TV in Your LivingRoom Is a Node in the AIScraping Economy
summary: Modern smart television sets are being utilized as distributed residential proxy nodes to harvest web data for training artificial intelligence models. As traditional public web sources are depleted, developers use residential IPs embedded in Smart TVs to bypass automated bot-detection mechanisms. This allows automated web scrapers to masquerade as standard home consumer traffic to ingest restricted online content. The process turns residential appliances into covert components of the AI data-gathering pipeline, raising significant concerns regarding user privacy, unconsented bandwidth utilization, and the ethics of unlicensed data harvesting for commercial machine learning datasets. (source: https://blog.includesecurity.com/2026/06/the-smart-tv-in-your-livingroom-is-a-node-in-the-aiscraping-economy/)
title_cn: 你客厅里的智能电视是 AI 数据抓取经济中的一个节点
summary_cn: 现代智能电视正被用作分布式住宅代理节点，以抓取网页数据用于训练人工智能模型。由于传统的公共网络资源枯竭，开发人员利用嵌入在智能电视中的住宅 IP 来绕过自动化机器人检测机制。这使得自动化网络爬虫能够伪装成普通的家庭消费者流量，从而获取受限制的在线内容。这一过程将住宅电器变成了 AI 数据收集管道的隐蔽组件，引发了关于用户隐私、未经同意的带宽利用以及商业机器学习数据集许可外数据抓取的伦理方面的重大担忧。

title: Impact of Advanced GPT Models on Mathematical Research Breakthroughs
summary: The mathematics research community is reporting significant productivity improvements through the use of advanced large language models, specifically the GPT-5 series. Researchers have noted that model iterations such as the GPT-5.5 Pro are increasingly being integrated into academic and applied workflows to assist with complex mathematical problem-solving, theoretical proofs, and scientific computation. This development suggests a growing paradigm shift where frontier models move beyond basic general-purpose tasks into specialized, highly rigorous technical disciplines. (source: https://x.com/polynoamial/status/2063059064549159195)
title_cn: 先进 GPT 模型对数学研究突破的影响
summary_cn: 数学研究界报告称，通过使用先进的大型语言模型，特别是 GPT-5 系列，研究生产力得到了显著提高。研究人员注意到，GPT-5.5 Pro 等模型迭代正越来越多地被整合到学术和应用工作流程中，以辅助复杂的数学问题解决、理论证明和科学计算。这一发展表明，前沿模型正在超越基本的通用任务，进入专门的、高度严谨的技术学科，形成了一种日益增长的范式转变。

title: Nikolay Savinov Joins OpenAI London Team Focusing On Pretraining
summary: OpenAI has recruited former DeepMind researcher Nikolay Savinov to join its London office, focusing on foundational model pretraining. Savinov, who has spent several years working on pretraining methodologies, will play a critical role in scaling the training infrastructure and development pipeline for OpenAI's next-generation large language models. This strategic hire underscores OpenAI's ongoing efforts to secure top-tier talent in Europe and expand its research presence in the competitive London artificial intelligence hub. (source: https://x.com/sama/status/2063077418748002510)
title_cn: Nikolay Savinov 加入 OpenAI 伦敦团队，专注于预训练
summary_cn: OpenAI 招募了前 DeepMind 研究员 Nikolay Savinov 加入其伦敦办事处，专注于基础模型预训练。Savinov 在预训练方法论方面拥有多年经验，将在扩展 OpenAI 下一代大型语言模型的训练基础设施和开发流水线方面发挥关键作用。此次战略性招聘凸显了 OpenAI 在欧洲吸引顶尖人才并扩大其在竞争激烈的伦敦人工智能中心研究影响力的持续努力。

title: LeRobot Introduces VLA-JEPA Model for Enhanced Robotic Learning
summary: The LeRobot open-source ecosystem has released VLA-JEPA, a model designed to advance robotic control and learning. Unlike traditional architectures that map sensory inputs directly to motor actions, VLA-JEPA utilizes Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) to build sophisticated world models. This strategy enables robotic agents to better interpret environmental shifts and predict future states during physical tasks. The model is now integrated into the LeRobot framework, aiming to bridge visual perception and motor execution for scalable robotic training. (source: https://x.com/Thom_Wolf/status/2063196466328248726)
title_cn: LeRobot 推出 VLA-JEPA 模型以增强机器人学习
summary_cn: LeRobot 开源生态系统发布了 VLA-JEPA，这是一个旨在推动机器人控制和学习的模型。与直接将感官输入映射到电机动作的传统架构不同，VLA-JEPA 利用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）来构建复杂的环境模型。这一策略使机器人代理能够更好地解释环境变化并在执行物理任务时预测未来状态。该模型现已集成到 LeRobot 框架中，旨在弥合视觉感知与电机执行之间的鸿沟，从而实现可扩展的机器人训练。

title: Streamlining Email Workflow Through Direct ChatGPT Integration
summary: OpenAI's Greg Brockman highlighted a new productivity milestone featuring the direct integration of ChatGPT into email clients. This technical capability allows users to automate the drafting, summarizing, and editing of complex email threads directly within their communication software. The deployment reflects a broader industry transition toward embedding agentic workflows and advanced large language models directly into standard business applications, minimizing the manual effort required to manage daily, information-dense correspondence. (source: https://x.com/gdb/status/2063056196735504796)
title_cn: 通过直接集成 ChatGPT 简化电子邮件工作流
summary_cn: OpenAI 的 Greg Brockman 强调了一个新的生产力里程碑，即 ChatGPT 与电子邮件客户端的直接集成。这一技术能力允许用户在通信软件内部直接自动化处理复杂邮件线程的起草、摘要和编辑。此次部署反映了行业向将代理工作流和先进大型语言模型直接嵌入标准业务应用的更广泛转型，最大限度地减少了管理日常信息密集型通信所需的人工劳动。

title: Persistent Bottlenecks Will Limit AI Progress To Linear Growth
summary: Nato Lambert issued a critical assessment of the AI agent hype cycle, arguing that non-algorithmic challenges will limit artificial intelligence progress to linear rather than exponential growth. Despite recent product announcements from Anthropic, Lambert points to persistent bottlenecks including compute infrastructure limitations, rigid organizational structures, and data access restrictions that impede rapid model scaling. The analysis suggests that overcoming these physical and structural constraints will require substantial time and effort, independent of software-level agentic developments. (source: https://x.com/natolambert/status/2063055447435956427)
title_cn: 持续的瓶颈将使 AI 进步局限于线性增长
summary_cn: Nato Lambert 对 AI 代理炒作周期进行了严厉评估，认为非算法挑战将使人工智能的进步局限于线性而非指数级增长。尽管 Anthropic 最近发布了产品，但 Lambert 指出，包括计算基础设施限制、僵化的组织结构和数据访问限制在内的持续瓶颈，阻碍了模型的快速扩展。该分析表明，克服这些物理和结构性限制需要大量时间和精力，这与软件层面的代理开发无关。
